Hi Dawn / Carlos —

Thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the ML/infra deep dive on calendar (target 60–90m):

Summary (from our call)
- Primary goal: validate inference latency and integration pattern for PHI-scoped pipelines, and confirm routing policy between hosted/dedicated/private modes.
- Key constraints: data residency in US-East, encrypted-at-rest KMS, and SOC2 evidence requested by IT.

Suggested next step
1) 60–90 minute Technical Deep Dive (ML/Infra) — covers architecture, deployment variants, and fallback routing policies
2) Attendees we recommend: Product/PM, Infra/Platform engineer, Security/Compliance SME (we can bring a Redwood security engineer if needed)

Candidate windows (all PT):
- Wed Jun 16 — 10:00–11:15 (preferred)
- Thu Jun 17 — 09:00–10:15 or 15:00–16:15

Attached: a lightweight mutual action plan (MAP) and a starter agenda for the TDX.

Ask for you: please confirm the preferred window and who from Alignly will join (esp the security contact). If those times don't work, tell me 3 slots that do and we will lock one.

If useful, we can include a short section on fallback behavior (model variant routing) in the agenda — we found customers like to agree on an explicit fallback plan up front.

Thanks,

Dylan Brooks
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

- Aditya Rao (Principal Solutions Architect) — will cover deployment variants & routing/fallback logic
- Grace O'Connor (Security Lead) — cover SOC2 / KMS / data-residency Qs

If you both confirm, I'll send the calendar invite and include Priya Natarajan when Dawn forwards her address. Also I recommend adding a short fallback demo snippet (30s video or trace screenshot) as an optional slide in case they want a quick visual.

Thanks — Dylan
